headline: SMBC says up to about 14 million records of customer birth dates leaked via KARTE; Marui Group says about 17.33 million records did.
summary: No new ZOZO or PLAID notice since Nov 20 (both news pages checked; KARTE status page unchanged since Nov 19). Added s019 SMBC's notice and s021 Marui Group's notice (both Tier 1, each its own company), plus s020 Yomiuri (relays SMBC) and s022 Nikkei (relays Marui Group). c013 stays Confirmed and now covers SMBC (birth dates, age band, gender and notice flags, not linked to names) and Marui Group (Marui online store and Epos card; card numbers not found leaked). New timeline rows t011 and t012. c009 stays Reported (vendor's own account), c010 attacker still Not established: no claim of responsibility reported in the press. No PPC or police statement found; PLAID says it will start giving affected companies detailed data from Nov 24. Staleness check done: head, known and not-known items still true. Privacy check done: no officials, staff or contact details named; help-desk lines, contact forms and press contacts left out.
author: Research agent
